paragraphs.text: Tested macOS safeguards, memory isolation patches and offline document tools for DeepSeek Harness
# DSH Second Agent Kit
**English** · 繁體中文
This kit adds small, separately testable safeguards to DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 on macOS. It asks
before risky browser and publishing actions, blocks network access and Apple Events for confined sh
ell commands, checks an Engram memory directory before an upgrade, and renders Office files for visu
al review. The kit is MIT licensed and does not change DSH Desktop's own license.
## Upstream status (2026-09-30)

Engram PR #4 was merged on
2026-09-21 and shipped in v0.7.7.
It adds opt-in `legacyMigration: conser

vative` and JSON migration-claim sidecars.
The default remains eager; this does not reconstruct owne

rship or make migration
crash-atomic. This kit still pins 0.7.6 as its reproducible verification bas
validating and upgrading the runtime is separate work.
## What is included
- **An approval plugin.** This Cordis plugin keeps every decision the host has already made. It adds
a confirmation step before browser writes, before borrowing an existing tab, and before common publ

ishing and deletion commands.
- **A restricted sandbox provider.** It is a subclass of the existing
DSH Seatbelt provider and keeps the host's filesystem policy. In addition, it denies IP networking a
nd Apple Events to **confined shell processes**. Local computation and writes inside the workspace s
till work. A shell network request needs the host's existing per-call escalation and the user's appr

oval. The dedicated browser, web and model tools follow their own policies.
- **Engram verification.
** The kit verifies stock Engram 0.7.6, provides a read-only upgrade preflight, and reproduces the r
eal SQLite migration behavior. Verified routing and explicit memory operations now come from upstrea

m. The old 0.7.5 patch is kept only as history.
- **An Office renderer.** `scripts/render-office.py`
is an independent LibreOffice renderer. It uses an isolated profile and explicit macOS system fonts
so that missing Chinese glyphs do not go unnoticed. It needs an official LibreOffice install, and `

--png` also needs PyMuPDF.
- **An experimental computer-use patch.** The live Word file-panel test *
*failed**, and this bundle does not enable the patch. The patch sends keys to the system XPC process
of a validated, focused file-panel element instead of silently posting them to the host app. It add
s no global input broadcast, no way around stale observations, and no new permanent app grant.
The guard also stops further Mac input within one agent turn after two consecutive known UI failures
or after 20 input calls. Observing the screen is still allowed and does not reset the count. A new
user turn does reset it. This limits how many tools are dispatched, not how much the model spends.
## Install the guard
You need macOS 14 or later, Node 24, DSH 0.1.5-rc.2, and the existing workspace-write plus ask mode.
Try it in a separate profile first.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle disables the upstream `sandbox` row, inserts `second-agent-sandbox` with the restricted p
rovider, and inserts `second-agent-approval`. If an earlier local `daily-approval` hook is installed
, disable that duplicate once you have confirmed this plugin works. Do not disable DSH's own user-ap
proval plugin. The kit needs no credentials and ships none.
If a sandbox runner is not supported, the kit fails instead of quietly running the command without c
onfinement. This version works only on macOS, on purpose. Do not leave danger-full-access enabled as
a standing default, because that mode bypasses the host's confinement by design.
Desktop 0.15.6 wrongly treats a local tarball as a missing directory and removes it when it starts.
Keep the extracted directory at a stable path.
## Engram verification and upgrade check
For the verified offline profile, use **unmodified Engram 0.7.6** with automatic ingestion and query
rewriting turned off. Before you upgrade an existing memory directory, run the read-only preflight,
and stop if it exits with any nonzero code:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The check never opens memory contents and never migrates files. For the workspaces you supply, it de
tects legacy filenames that could belong to more than one of them. The verification runs six cases a
gainst the real plugin and SQLite through HonestCI, with no skipped tests allowed. The pinned 0.7.6
baseline still has the legacy ownership ambiguity, and reproducing that ambiguity is not a safety pa
ss. The upgrade guidance and its limits explain the details.
`scripts/patch-engram.py` and `tests/memory-runtime.mjs` are historical 0.7.5 artifacts. They are no
t instructions for the new default profile.
## Computer-use patch
The patch is `patches/computer-use.patch`, and the upstream commit it applies to is recorded in `pat
ches/computer-use-base.txt`. Apply it only to that commit, install the dependencies, and run the ups
tream `pnpm run build` so that the JavaScript and native artifacts are rebuilt together. You must bu
ild the native helper locally, because this repository supplies no downloaded executable that has no
t been reviewed. The tests include a standalone Swift check of the routing policy. The upstream pack
age remains MIT licensed, and its license sits next to the patch.
## Office rendering
Install LibreOffice from https://www.libreoffice.org/, and install PyMuPDF in a separate Python envi
e from https://www.libreoffice.org/, and install PyMuPDF in a separate Python environment. Then run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The helper refuses to overwrite an existing PDF and prints the page count. Look at every PNG yoursel
f. LibreOffice's layout is not proof of Microsoft Word's layout, and spreadsheet calculation or pres
entation animation still has to be checked in the target application.
## Verification and boundaries
`npm test` checks the hook behavior and the handling of unsupported runners. It also checks that the
macOS kernel actually denies TCP sockets and writes outside the workspace while allowing a write in
side it. The pure Swift policy checks reject keyboard targets that are inactive, unobserved, untrust
ure Swift policy checks reject keyboard targets that are inactive, unobserved, untrusted or invalid.
